title: Frontend Developer Intern
description: Build accessible interface components for a student-facing learning app. You will pair with a senior engineer and ship at least two features to production.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Clean survey data, build dashboards, and present weekly findings to the operations team. Comfort with spreadsheets is required.

title: UX Research Intern
description: Plan and run short usability interviews, then turn the notes into clear recommendations for the product designers.

title: Backend Engineering Intern
description: Help design and test REST endpoints for a logistics platform. You will write integration tests and review database queries.

title: Content Marketing Intern
description: Draft blog posts and newsletters, research topics with the editors, and track which pieces readers actually finish.

title: Machine Learning Intern
description: Evaluate small language models on support tickets and document where they fail. Expect lots of careful error analysis.

title: Mobile App Intern
description: Implement screens and offline caching for a field-service Android app under the guidance of the mobile lead.

title: Operations Intern
description: Shadow dispatch coordinators, record delays, and propose small process fixes that the team can try the following week.

title: Cybersecurity Intern
description: Assist with dependency audits, write security checklists, and help triage findings from automated scanners.

title: Graphic Design Intern
description: Produce social media graphics and slide templates for a small group of consumer brands, working from a shared style guide.

title: Finance Intern
description: Reconcile monthly accounts, prepare simple variance reports, and help the controller with audit documents.

title: Full-Stack Intern
description: Work across a React frontend and a Node API for a clinic booking tool. You will own a small feature from design to deploy.
